tool.name: disassembler harvest
tool.description: merge kmindex query shards into per-target candidate accessions
tool.command:
## harvest reads *.json non-recursively from one directory. Shards are staged ## under their position in the collection so unusual element identifiers can ## neither collide nor escape the directory. mkdir shards && #for $i, $shard in enumerate($shards): ln -s '$shard' 'shards/${i}.json' && #end for disassembler harvest --shards-dir shards --out-dir candidates &&
## Moved out so the per-target accession collection does not pick up the union. mv candidates/UNION.accessions.txt union.accessions.txt && mv candidates/summary.json summary.json

param.name: shards
param.label: kmindex query results
param.help: The JSON output collection of the kmindex query tool, one dataset per index shard.

tool.help:
@HELP_SUITE@
-----
What it does ************
Merges the per-shard results of a kmindex query against the Logan planetary index into one ranked candidate list per target. A target is one record of the kmindex query FASTA (typically one gene).
For every accession the highest containment score across all shards is kept. Accessions are ranked by that score, highest first. Accessions that scored 0 are dropped. The phiX174 Illumina spike-in is excluded by target name.
-----
Input *****
The JSON output collection of the **kmindex query** tool, one dataset per index shard. Empty shards (no hits) are normal and are counted, not treated as errors. The tool fails if every shard is unreadable.
-----
Outputs *******
- **Candidate accessions**: a collection with one list of SRA run accessions per target, one accession per line, ranked by score. This is the input for **disassembler walker**. - **Scores**: a collection with one JSON object per target mapping each accession to its containment score. This is the input for **disassembler stratify**. - **All candidate accessions**: the sorted union of every target's list. - **Summary**: per-target candidate counts and maximum scores, plus the size of the union.
